title: Per-pass correctness lemmas for erasure, dearging and match-on-box removal, composed in extract_correct
intent: Reduce the end-to-end correctness of the verified extraction pipeline — that a PCUIC constant evaluating to a constructor extracts to an erased, dearged, match-on-box-removed λ□ term evaluating to the same constructor — to one correctness lemma per pass (erases_correct, dearg_transform_correct, optimize_correct) plus the typing, well-formedness and dependency-closure lemmas their premises need, so extract_correct is a 51-line composition that never re-proves a pass.

parent.name: extract_correct
parent.statement:
Theorem extract_correct
        (H := EWellformed.all_env_flags)
        (wfl := opt_wcbv_flags)
        (Σ : P.global_env_ext) (wfΣ : ∥wf_ext Σ∥)
        kn ui ind c ui' ignored exΣ :
  axiom_free Σ ->
  welltyped Σ [] (P.tConst kn ui) ->
  Σ p⊢ P.tConst kn ui ⇓ P.tConstruct ind c ui' ->
  (isErasable Σ [] (P.tConstruct ind c ui') -> False) ->
  (forall k, ignored k = false) ->
  extract_pcuic_env
    (pcuic_args extract_within_coq)
    Σ (wf_squash wfΣ) (KernameSet.singleton kn) ignored = Ok exΣ ->
  ∥trans_env exΣ e⊢ E.tConst kn ⇓ E.tConstruct ind c []∥.

children.name: erases_correct
children.statement:
Lemma erases_correct (wfl := default_wcbv_flags) Σ t t' v Σ' :
  wf_ext Σ ->
  welltyped Σ [] t ->
  Σ;;; [] |- t ⇝ℇ t' ->
  erases_deps Σ Σ' t' ->
  Σ |-p t ⇓ v ->
  exists v', Σ;;; [] |- v ⇝ℇ v' /\ ∥ Σ' ⊢ t' ⇓ v' ∥.
children.closed_by: induction on the eval derivation; each case closed by inversion_App / inversion_LetIn, erases_subst and the induction hypotheses (Qed.)
children.note: The erasure pass: a well-typed term t erasing to t' and evaluating to v yields v' with v erasing to v' and t' evaluating to v'. The largest child; proved in erasure/theories/ErasureCorrectness.v, stated and proved before extract_correct.

children.name: dearg_transform_correct
children.statement:
Lemma dearg_transform_correct {wfl : WcbvFlags} overridden_masks do_trim_const_masks do_trim_ctor_masks :
  ExtractTransformCorrect (dearg_transform overridden_masks do_trim_const_masks do_trim_ctor_masks true true true).
children.closed_by: dearg_correct (after reducing to eval_debox_env_types, eval_const_construct_expanded, eval_is_expanded_aux)
children.note: The dearging pass, stated as ExtractTransformCorrect (dearg_transform overridden_masks do_trim_const_masks do_trim_ctor_masks true true true). Closes by reducing to dearg_correct.

children.name: optimize_correct
children.statement:
Lemma optimize_correct `{EWellformed.EEnvFlags} Σ fgΣ t v :
  ELiftSubst.closed t = true ->
  EGlobalEnv.closed_env (trans_env Σ) = true ->
  EWellformed.wf_glob (trans_env Σ) ->
  @EWcbvEval.eval default_wcbv_flags (trans_env Σ) t v ->
  @EWcbvEval.eval
      (EWcbvEval.disable_prop_cases opt_wcbv_flags)
      (trans_env (map (on_snd (remove_match_on_box_decl (EEnvMap.GlobalContextMap.make (trans_env Σ) (OptimizePropDiscr.trans_env_fresh_globals _ fgΣ)))) Σ))
      (EOptimizePropDiscr.remove_match_on_box (EEnvMap.GlobalContextMap.make (trans_env Σ) (OptimizePropDiscr.trans_env_fresh_globals _ fgΣ)) t)
      (EOptimizePropDiscr.remove_match_on_box (EEnvMap.GlobalContextMap.make (trans_env Σ) (OptimizePropDiscr.trans_env_fresh_globals _ fgΣ)) v).
children.note: The match-on-box removal pass (OptimizePropDiscr), stated locally in ExtractionCorrectness.v. Closes by eapply of remove_match_on_box_correct.

children.name: wf_erase_global_decls_recursive
children.statement:
Lemma wf_erase_global_decls_recursive (H := EWellformed.all_env_flags) :
  forall X_type X decls univs retros w seeds (ignored : kername -> bool),
    (forall k, ignored k = false) ->
    let Σex := @Erasure.erase_global_decls_deps_recursive X_type X decls univs retros w seeds ignored in
    EWellformed.wf_glob (trans_env Σex).
children.closed_by: induction decls; eapply wf_erase_global_decl; eauto (plus fresh_globals_erase_global_decl_rec)
children.note: Well-formedness of the recursively erased global environment; discharges optimize_correct's wf_glob (trans_env eΣ) hypothesis.

children.name: global_erased_with_deps_erases_deps_tConst
children.statement:
Lemma global_erased_with_deps_erases_deps_tConst Σ Σer kn cst :
  wf Σ ->
  P.declared_constant Σ kn cst ->
  global_erased_with_deps Σ Σer kn ->
  erases_deps Σ Σer (E.tConst kn).
children.closed_by: destruct glob; econstructor; eauto (the inductive case via lookup_env_In)
children.note: Dependency closure: a declared, globally-erased-with-deps constant is erased-with-deps. A 12-line leaf closing by case analysis.

children.name: erase_global_decls_deps_recursive_correct
children.statement:
Lemma erase_global_decls_deps_recursive_correct decls univs retro wfΣ include ignore_deps :
  let Σ := mk_global_env univs decls retro in
  (forall k, ignore_deps k = false) ->
  (forall k, KernameSet.In k include -> P.lookup_env Σ k <> None) ->
  includes_deps Σ (trans_env (erase_global_decls_deps_recursive (X_type := X_type) (X := X) decls univs retro wfΣ include ignore_deps)) include.
children.note: The recursively erased environment includes its dependencies (includes_deps); an 8-line wrapper over the _gen variant.

children.name: inversion_Const
children.statement:
Lemma inversion_Const :
    forall {Γ c u T},
      Σ ;;; Γ |- tConst c u : T ->
      ∑ decl,
        wf_local Σ Γ ×
        declared_constant Σ c decl ×
        (consistent_instance_ext Σ decl.(cst_universes) u) ×
        Σ ;;; Γ ⊢ subst_instance u (cst_type decl) ≤ T.
children.note: Typing inversion for tConst, from the PCUIC metatheory (PCUICInversion.v); gives the declared_constant that erases_correct's erases_deps hypothesis needs.

children.name: fresh_globals_erase_global_decl_rec
children.statement:
Lemma fresh_globals_erase_global_decl_rec :
    forall X_type X (Σ0 : global_declarations) (universes0 : ContextSet.t) (retroknowledge0 : Retroknowledge.t)
           wfΣ
           (seeds : KernameSet.t) (ignore : kername -> bool),
      EnvMap.EnvMap.fresh_globals Σ0 ->
      ExAst.fresh_globals (@erase_global_decls_deps_recursive X_type X Σ0 universes0 retroknowledge0 wfΣ seeds ignore).
children.closed_by: induction Σ0; in the cons case constructor with IHΣ0 and fresh_global_erase_global_decl_rec (Qed.)
children.note: Discharges the shelved freshness obligation of the parent's final Unshelve (ExtractionCorrectness.v:578). Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Freshness of the recursively erased global environment.

applicability.goal_shape: A theorem that a whole pipeline — a composition of passes — preserves evaluation. Each pass is a function on a global environment whose correctness is stated as ExtractTransformCorrect: if the source evaluates tConst kn to tConstruct ind c [], so does the transformed environment. The parent's conclusion has the shape trans_env exΣ e⊢ E.tConst kn ⇓ E.tConstruct ind c [].
applicability.use_when: The pipeline is a fixed sequence of independently specifiable passes, each with a self-contained statement that closes from the definitions plus one per-pass lemma (dearg_correct, remove_match_on_box_correct); the parent can discharge each pass's side conditions (wf_glob, erases_deps) with named supporting lemmas.
applicability.avoid_when: A pass's correctness depends on the output of the next pass (the passes are not independent, so no self-contained per-pass statement exists); or the side conditions cannot be stated as their own lemmas and would have to be re-proved inline at every call site.

claims.claim: No admit, Admitted or Axiom closes any goal in extract_correct's proof, erasure/theories/Typed/ExtractionCorrectness.v lines 530-580.
erases_correct is cited by the parent site.

The same per-pass composition is codified as a reusable combinator: compose_transforms_correct proves that a list of ExtractTransformCorrect transforms composes to an ExtractTransformCorrect transform, generalising the one-lemma-per-pass pattern extract_correct uses by hand.

The main theorem extract_correct composes 8 direct project lemmas in a 51-line parent site; the eight children (declaration and proof) span 1182, 22, 22, 37, 12, 8, 11 and 19 lines (1313 in total); the deepest chain below the theorem is extract_correct -> erases_correct -> inversion_App and extract_correct -> dearg_transform_correct -> dearg_correct, depth 2.

consequences: The move produces one obligation per pass plus its side conditions. The three pass lemmas differ hugely in size: erases_correct is 1182 lines (erasure correctness is the hard part), while dearg_transform_correct and optimize_correct are 22 lines each because they reduce to a single existing lemma (dearg_correct, remove_match_on_box_correct). The glue must discharge each pass's hypotheses in the exact shape the pass lemma expects (wf_glob via wf_erase_global_decls_recursive, erases_deps via inversion_Const + global_erased_with_deps_erases_deps_tConst + erase_global_decls_deps_recursive_correct); a wrong shape fails the eapply. A failure mode: if the passes share state, their lemmas are not self-contained and the composition needs an invariant threaded through all of them instead.
